findings.title: Merge tickets allows CLOSED source ticket without state validation

violation.rule: Source ticket must not be CLOSED for merge operation
violation.expected_behavior: Return 409 Conflict when source ticket status is CLOSED
violation.actual_behavior: Merge succeeds (200 OK) with CLOSED source ticket

findings.root_cause: merge_tickets handler lacks source ticket status check before performing merge
findings.impact: CLOSED tickets can be merged, violating ticket lifecycle integrity

findings.title: SLA update succeeds despite active tickets referencing the SLA

violation.rule: Cannot update SLA parameters when active tickets reference it
violation.expected_behavior: Return 409 Conflict when active (non-CLOSED) tickets reference the SLA
violation.actual_behavior: SLA update succeeds (200 OK) despite active tickets

reproduction_steps: 2. Create ticket with sla_id (POST /tickets) → OPEN, references SLA

findings.root_cause: update_sla handler lacks active ticket impact check before modifying SLA parameters
findings.impact: SLA terms can be changed under active tickets, breaking contractual SLA guarantees
